notes.title: Monster Looter DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]Ready to loot monsters? ⚔️[/h1][p]Our brand-new game [b]Monster Looter[/b] is here, a fresh [b]Idle/Clicker experience[/b] where your goal is simple but addictive: hunt monsters, collect epic loot, and grow stronger with every battle.[/p][p]If you enjoyed [b]Supermarket Billionaire[/b], then you’ll feel right at home with Monster Looter — but this time, the loot fights back! 🐉💥
Upgrade your team, discover new monsters, and let the game do the grinding while you focus on the fun of looting.[/p][p]The [b]Monster Looter demo[/b] is available now for FREE on Steam!
We’re getting ready for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and your feedback means the world to us. Jump in, try it out, and help us make Monster Looter the best monster-clicker adventure out there![/p][p]👉 Download the demo today and start looting![/p][p]PS. Updates are coming to Supermarket Billionaire. But it's a secret.... Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh... ;) [/p]

notes.title: Supermarket Billionaire is officially out today!
notes.content: [h1] Supermarket Billionaire is officially out today! ːsteamthumbsupː[/h1][p]After months of hard work, we’re excited to finally share Supermarket Billionaire with you our brand new idle game where you build and grow your own supermarket empire![/p][p]Buy and upgrade products, hire employees, improve your facilities, and optimize every part of your business to become the next big billionaire![/p][p]We want to give a huge thank you to everyone who supported us during development your encouragement, feedback, and patience mean the world. [/p][p]This is just the beginning: we have many exciting updates and features planned, and we can’t wait to shape this game together with the community.[/p][p]Let us know what you think, and thank you again for being part of this journey![/p][p][/p]
